note:
Chosen by what had already been looked at, not by preference. Every trajectory on disk on this
date is withheld x fifty-year-embargo — that cell is where the L2 A/B was measured and where the
thresholds were watched, so it is in-sample beyond argument. Of what was left, one position and
one brief were frozen and are not to be run during development.

The rule: no run against a held-out cell while any threshold, prompt, checker or rubric is still
being changed. `artist grid` will not include them without --include-held-out, which prints this
note. When the environment is finally still, run them once and report those numbers separately.

This is a freeze against tuning and nothing more. The held-out position was written by the same
author in the same week against the same constraint kinds and is graded by the same checker.
See docs/artist/MEASUREMENT.md, "who wrote the thing being measured".

breaks.why: The hard-constraint budget. Two full runs were spent clearing hard `requireNode`/`requireMark` constraints by swapping one op for another with no visible change to the picture, so counting kinds may no longer be hard and no position may carry more than four hard decidable constraints. Every position on disk was rewritten to that rule in the same pass, this one included, and `many-hands` was cut from thirteen hard constraints to four the same way `interference` and `withheld` were. Not tuning: no run against this cell was consulted, and no threshold here was moved to make a failing check pass — the surviving four are its own former constraints re-expressed against the canvas, and what was cut went into judge rubrics. But the freeze from 2026-08-31 is dead for this document, and any number taken on it from here is held out only from what came after.
